{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CeLfvKjzm9KsBnEZrLpa7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GqHwrxPB32uFeibWjGdRAf","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-v2cwme_q/project/parts/valve_knob.py","content":"from build123d import *\nfrom nurb import *\nfrom measurements import shaft_diameter, shaft_across_flat\n\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(\n    shaft_diameter: float = 8.0,\n    shaft_across_flat: float = 6.5,\n    knob_height: float = 16.0,\n    bottom_diameter: float = 34.0,\n):\n    \"\"\"D-shaft valve knob with torque transmission via flat bore.\n    The bore opens upward on the vertical centerline with the shaft's flat facing +X.\n\n    shaft_diameter: stem diameter at widest point (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: stem width across the flat (mm)\n    knob_height: total height of knob (mm)\n    bottom_diameter: diameter of knob base for grip (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Main knob body\n    knob = Cylinder(radius=bottom_diameter / 2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # Bore dimensions: fit 0.3mm grown stem, jam 1.0mm grown stem\n    # With 0.3mm clearance on all sides\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.6  # 8.6 mm\n    bore_flat_width = shaft_across_flat + 0.6  # 7.1 mm\n\n    # Distance from center to the flat side (preserved from shaft proportions)\n    flat_depth = (shaft_diameter - shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, depth=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, depth=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # Cut bore from knob\n    result = knob.cut(bore)\n\n    # Chamfer the external top edges for finish\n    top_edges = [e for e in result.edges() if abs(e.center.z - knob_height) < 0.1]\n    if top_edges:\n        result = chamfer(result, top_edges, length=0.8)\n\n    return result\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2131,"cache_read_input_tokens":31709,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2131},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0831d5cd-32d3-483e-a0b8-dba4e5342d1a","uuid":"6e042660-2ae4-4e9f-a3b5-ac7d1e153193","timestamp":"2026-08-24T01:03:08.460Z","request_id":"req_011CeLfvKBGRUCoqRpADxZRS"}

shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, depth=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, depth=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # Cut bore from knob\n    result = knob.cut(bore)\n\n    # Chamfer the external top edges for finish\n    top_edges = [e for e in result.edges() if abs(e.center.z - shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # Cut bore from knob\n    result = knob.cut(bore)\n\n    # Chamfer the top rim edges for finish\n    result = chamfer(result, [e for e in result.edges()], length=0.5)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":58,"oldLines":7,"newStart":58,"newLines":4,"lines":["     # Cut bore from knob","     result = knob.cut(bore)"," ","-    # Chamfer the top rim edges for finish","-    result = chamfer(result, [e for e in result.edges()], length=0.5)","-","     return result"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # Cut bore from knob\n    result = knob.cut(bore)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":7,"oldLines":7,"newStart":7,"newLines":7,"lines":["     shaft_diameter: float = 8.0,","     shaft_across_flat: float = 6.5,","     knob_height: float = 16.0,","-    bottom_diameter: float = 34.0,","+    bottom_diameter: float = 33.0,"," ):","     \"\"\"D-shaft valve knob with torque transmission via flat bore.","     The bore opens upward on the vertical centerline with the shaft's flat facing +X."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

8.6 mm\n27\t    bore_flat_width = shaft_across_flat + 0.6  # 7.1 mm\n28\t\n29\t    # Distance from center to the flat side (preserved from shaft proportions)\n30\t    flat_depth = (shaft_diameter - shaft_across_flat) / 2  # Main knob body\n    knob = Cylinder(radius=bottom_diameter / 2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # Bore dimensions: fit 0.3mm grown stem, jam 1.0mm grown stem\n    # With 0.3mm clearance on all sides\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.6  # 8.6 mm\n    bore_flat_width = shaft_across_flat + 0.6  # 7.1 mm\n\n    # Distance from center to the flat side (preserved from shaft proportions)\n    flat_depth = (shaft_diameter - shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CeLg7WYgeJ4B3EXUJ9Bhx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014UsoQ8reagSL3qp3LCEftG","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-v2cwme_q/project/parts/valve_knob.py","old_string":"    # Main knob body\n    knob = Cylinder(radius=bottom_diameter / 2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # Bore dimensions: fit 0.3mm grown stem, jam 1.0mm grown stem\n    # With 0.3mm clearance on all sides\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.6  # 8.6 mm\n    bore_flat_width = shaft_across_flat + 0.6  # 7.1 mm\n\n    # Distance from center to the flat side (preserved from shaft proportions)\n    flat_depth = (shaft_diameter - Main knob body\n    knob = Cylinder(radius=bottom_diameter / 2, height=knob_height)","originalFile":"from build123d import *\nfrom nurb import *\n\n\n@part\ndef valve_knob(\n    shaft_diameter: float = 8.0,\n    shaft_across_flat: float = 6.5,\n    knob_height: float = 16.0,\n    bottom_diameter: float = 33.0,\n):\n    \"\"\"D-shaft valve knob with torque transmission via flat bore.\n    The bore opens upward on the vertical centerline with the shaft's flat facing +X.\n\n    shaft_diameter: stem diameter at widest point (mm)\n    shaft_across_flat: stem width across the flat (mm)\n    knob_height: total height of knob (mm)\n    bottom_diameter: diameter of knob base for grip (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    # Main knob body: cylinder with 4 lobes for grip\n    knob = Cylinder(radius=bottom_diameter / 2, height=knob_height)\n\n    # Add 4 lobes for better grip and to meet grip requirement\n    lobe_radius = 2.0  # Extends knob beyond cylinder\n    lobe_height = knob_height * 0.6  # Lobes on upper portion\n\n    for angle in [0, 90, 180, 270]:\n        # Position lobes at cardinal directions\n        lobe_offset = bottom_diameter / 2 + lobe_radius * 0.7\n        x = lobe_offset * (1 if angle in [0, 270] else -1) if angle in [0, 180] else 0\n        y = lobe_offset * (1 if angle in [90, 180] else -1) if angle in [90, 270] else 0\n\n        lobe = Cylinder(radius=lobe_radius, height=lobe_height)\n        lobe = lobe.move(Location((x, y, lobe_height / 2)))\n        knob = knob.fuse(lobe)\n\n    # Bore dimensions: fit 0.3mm grown stem, jam 1.0mm grown stem\n    # With 0.3mm clearance on all sides\n    bore_diameter = shaft_diameter + 0.6  # 8.6 mm\n    bore_flat_width = shaft_across_flat + 0.6  # 7.1 mm\n\n    # Distance from center to the flat side (preserved from shaft proportions)\n    flat_depth = (shaft_diameter - shaft_across_flat) / 2  # 0.75 mm\n\n    # Bore extends 13mm up into the knob (1mm past stem height of 12mm)\n    bore_height = 13.0\n    bore_z = knob_height - bore_height\n\n    # Create D-shaped bore with two parts\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sketch:\n        # Outer circle part of the D\n        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)\n    bore_round = extrude(sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Flat part of the D - creates the torque-transmitting flat\n    # The flat extends inward from the bore to ensure contact\n    flat_reach = bore_diameter / 2 + 0.5  # Extends past center\n\n    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as flat_sketch:\n        Rectangle(bore_flat_width, flat_reach * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n    bore_flat = extrude(flat_sketch.sketch, amount=bore_height)\n\n    # Position the flat so its outer edge is at -Y (shaft flat facing +X means -Y face)\n    bore_flat = bore_flat.move(Location((0, -flat_reach + flat_depth, 0)))\n\n    # Combine bore components\n    bore = bore_round\n    bore = bore.fuse(bore_flat)\n    bore = bore.move(Location((0, 0, bore_z)))\n\n    # Cut bore from knob\n    result = knob.cut(bore)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":18,"oldLines":23,"newStart":18,"newLines":9,"lines":["     bottom_diameter: diameter of knob base for grip (mm)","     \"\"\""," ","-    #
